title: Pliant to Highlight New Wireless Intercom Accessories at 2026 NAB Show

One major bottleneck is communication: crew members need to be able to talk to each other quickly and reliably, without interference, in a variety of environments. This is where wireless intercom systems come in – and Pliant's new accessories may be a game-changer.
